title: T-Rexatron Alienwolf III, A Prequel In Time: The Unrelenting
description: In a world where chaos reigns like cats and dogs in a hailstorm of passion, a retired cop must settle one last score.
quote: Captain, if I don’t make it out of here alive, tell my little boy I love him.
